title: Dy. General Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Designation:**
Deputy General Manager (DGM) – National Sales Manager
  
  
**Business Unit:**
Lightning Structure (HMP)
  
  
**Experience:**
15+ Years
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director / Business Head
  
  
**Location:**

* Initial: Matar Manufacturing Facility (First 6 months)
* Subsequent Posting: Bhubaneswar (Head Office / Sales HQ)

**Role Overview**
The Deputy General Manager – National Sales will be responsible for driving pan-India sales strategy and execution for the Lightning Structure (HMP) business. The role demands strong leadership, deep B2B industrial sales expertise, and the ability to scale revenue by building high-performing sales teams, strategic customer relationships, and robust channel networks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Sales Strategy & Business Growth**

* Define and execute the national sales strategy for Lightning Structure (HMP) products aligned with organizational goals.
* Drive top-line revenue growth, market share expansion, and profitability across India.
* Identify new industry segments, EPC opportunities, and key accounts in infrastructure, power, renewables, industries, and government projects.
* Lead annual sales planning, forecasting, budgeting, and target setting.

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing national sales team, including regional and key account managers.
* Set KPIs, review performance regularly, and ensure capability development of the sales force.
* Foster a strong sales culture focused on accountability, results, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Account & Channel Management**

* Manage strategic national accounts, consultants, EPCs, and large institutional customers.
* Strengthen and expand channel partner, dealer, and distributor networks across regions.
* Negotiate and close high-value contracts, tenders, and long-term agreements.

**Market Intelligence & Product Positioning**

* Track market trends, competitor activity, pricing dynamics, and customer feedback.
* Collaborate with marketing and product teams to refine product positioning, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies.
* Support new product launches and solution-based selling initiatives.

**Cross-functional Coordination**

* Work closely with manufacturing, supply chain, finance, quality, and projects teams to ensure timely execution and customer satisfaction.
* Spend the initial 6 months at the Matar facility to gain in-depth understanding of products, processes, costing, and capacity planning.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure adherence to company policies, pricing guidelines, ethical sales practices, and statutory requirements.
* Represent the company professionally at industry forums, exhibitions, and customer meets.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical / Electrical / Civil preferred).
* MBA / PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum 15+ years of progressive sales experience, with at least 5 years in a senior/national sales leadership role.
* Strong exposure to B2B manufacturing-driven sales, preferably in:

+ Lightning protection systems
+ Structural steel / HMP / fabrication
+ Power, infrastructure, renewables, or industrial products

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Proven track record of scaling national businesses and leading large sales teams
* Strong negotiation, contract management, and key account handling skills
* Deep understanding of project-based and EPC-driven sales
* Strategic thinking with hands-on execution capability
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
* Willingness to travel extensively across India

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**Key Account Manager, Assurant\-India**
 The Key account Manager is primarily responsible for development of Business and ensure to increase the penetration rate.
   

  

 Contribute to the continuous improvement of the business by actively identifying opportunities to improve processes and/or procedures.
   

  

**This position will be based out of Patna, Bihar, East Zone, OR Bhubaneswar, Orissa India.**
**What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?**
* First level of contact for all queries from the OEM dealer
* To drive the sales through the OEM dealers in the assigned territory to achieve the desired product numbers and attachment ratio.
* Build relationships with various stakeholders \[Sales/Service/Warranty Team/Accounts/team] at dealer and with OEM field team.
* Regular Interactions with Dealer Principle’s for business development
* Identifying the dealer sales team member wise attachment ratio to drive the business
* Train, motivate and align the dealership staff to promote the sales
* Receivables/ Payables management for the assigned dealers


**What are the requirements needed for this position?**
* BE/MBA preferred
* 4 \- 6 years of minimum experience in the field of Client \& Dealer management
* Must have Skills: Sales and Marketing Skill, Knowledge of OEMs Motor Dealership Business
* Preferred Skills: Problem solving, Understanding \& Adaptability, Hardworking \& Optimistic.
* Travel visits to dealers will be required.


 If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.
   

  

 Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender\-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.
